evals.name: arxiv-url-to-markdown
evals.prompt: Convert https://arxiv.org/abs/1706.03762 into a markdown file for my notes. I care about the math staying readable.
evals.expected_output: A markdown file of the paper 'Attention Is All You Need' with proper heading hierarchy, native $...$/$$...$$ math (e.g. the attention equation), citation keys, and extracted figures.
expectations: A markdown file of the paper exists in the outputs directory with substantial content (at least 3000 characters)
The markdown has a heading hierarchy of at least 8 ATX headings (#, ##, etc.) covering the paper's sections
The paper's core math survives as native markdown math: an Attention(Q,K,V) = softmax(QK^T/sqrt(d_k)) style formula appears inside $ or $$ delimiters
In-text citations are preserved rather than dropped (at least 5 occurrences of [@key]-style markers, or rendered author-year citations)
A References section is present with bibliography entries (or the conversion tool explained why references were unavailable)
Figures are extracted as real files and referenced from the markdown (or the output explains figure handling)
Output contains no conversion garbage: no '(cid:' artifacts and at most 2 raw LaTeX leftovers such as unconverted \begin{...} lines outside math blocks

evals.name: local-arxiv-pdf-to-markdown
evals.prompt: There's a PDF in the workspace directory called Discovery_of_a_13-Sharpe_OOS_Factor_Drift_Regimes_Unlock_Hidden_Cross-Sectional_Predictability.pdf. Please turn it into a markdown file — last time I converted it the headings and tables came out mangled, so I want a clean result this time.
evals.expected_output: A markdown file of the paper with numbered headings (e.g. '# 1 Introduction'), intact pipe tables for Tables 1-14, $$...$$ math for equations 1-5, figures in a media/ folder, and no reversed-text or (cid:) artifacts.
expectations: A markdown file of the paper exists in the outputs directory with substantial content (at least 10000 characters)
Section headings are real markdown headings and follow the PDF's numbering (e.g. '# 1 Introduction' and '## 3.1 Out-of-Sample Performance' style), with at least 10 headings total
Tables render as markdown pipe tables with aligned columns (at least 80 table rows starting with '|'), and table captions carry their numbers (Table 1 ... Table 14)
The paper's equations survive as native math, e.g. an UpFraction formula with sum over k=1..63 rendered in $$ delimiters rather than scattered text
The rotated arXiv stamp is not emitted as reversed text (output must not contain the string 'viXra')
No '(cid:' glyph artifacts anywhere in the output
Figures are extracted as real image files referenced from the markdown (media folder with at least 3 files, or at least 3 image links)
